title: What is tasawwuf?
summary: Tasawwuf as Hazrat Azam Pasha R.A. explains it while reading Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara: an inner knowledge whose source is the Qur'an and the Hadith, for the reform of both body and soul.
ru_summary: Tasawwuf, jaisa Hazrat Azam Pasha R.A. Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara padhte hue samjhaate hain: ek baatini ilm jiska sarchashma Qur'an aur Hadith hai, jism aur rooh dono ki islaah ke liye.

title: The purpose of the path
summary: What the murshids want for the murid, and the stations Hazrat names along the way: tawbah, taqwa, tawakkul, sabr, tasleem, raza, fana and baqa.
ru_summary: Murshid murid ke liye kya chahte hain, aur raaste ke woh maqaamaat jo Hazrat ginwaate hain: tauba, taqwa, tawakkul, sabr, tasleem, raza, fana aur baqa.

title: The scale, Islam and Iman
summary: How Hazrat describes the weighing of deeds on the Day of Gathering, being with the one you love, and the difference between Islam and Iman.
ru_summary: Hazrat Hashr ke din aamaal ke tole jaane ko, jis se mohabbat ho uske saath hone ko, aur Islam aur Imaan ke farq ko kaise bayaan karte hain.

title: What is Bai'at?
summary: Bai'at is a covenant: a pledge on something important, taken at the hand of a murshid. Hazrat explains it from the book Haqeeqat-e-Bai'at.
ru_summary: Bai'at ek ahad hai: kisi aham cheez par ahad lena, murshid ke haath par. Hazrat isko kitaab Haqeeqat-e-Bai'at se samjhaate hain.

title: Why a pir or shaykh?
ur: پیر یا شیخ کی ضرورت کیوں؟
summary: If the Qur'an, the hadith and the books of fiqh are in front of us, why give bai'at at anyone's hand? Hazrat's answers: the teacher, the one trusted guide, the power of company, and love for Allah's sake.
ru_summary: Jab Qur'an, hadith aur fiqh ki kitaabein hamare saamne hain, to kisi ke haath par bai'at kyun karein? Hazrat ke jawaab: ustaad, ek bharose ka rehnuma, sohbat ki taaqat, aur Allah ke liye mohabbat.

title: Conditions and adab of the murid
summary: Who can give bai'at, how to choose a murshid, how to sit in his company, what to do after a slip, and how Hazrat speaks of khilafat.
ru_summary: Bai'at kaun de sakta hai, murshid ko kaise chunein, unki sohbat mein kaise baithein, ghalti ho jaaye to kya karein, aur Hazrat khilafat ke baare mein kya farmate hain.

title: How to take Bai'at in this app
summary: What the Taking Bai'at screen shows, and how to send a request so the Khalifa can contact you. The app does not give bai'at itself.
ru_title: Is app mein Bai'at kaise lein
ru_summary: Taking Bai'at screen par kya dikhta hai, aur request kaise bhejein taaki Khalifa aap se raabta kar sakein. App khud bai'at nahin deti.

title: The schedule of deeds: Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara
summary: The book Hazrat Azam Pasha R.A. read in his dars, 'the timetable of those who count themselves poor in the way of Allah', and the order of its lessons.
ru_summary: Woh kitaab jo Hazrat Azam Pasha R.A. apne dars mein padhte the, 'un logon ka time-table jo Allah ke raaste mein apne aap ko faqeer samajhte hain', aur uske asbaaq ki tarteeb.

title: Chilla and i'tikaf
summary: What a chilla is, how Hazrat links it to i'tikaf, and why the thought on one point is 'the soul of worship'.
ru_summary: Chilla kya hai, Hazrat isko i'tikaf se kaise jodte hain, aur ek nukte par khayal ko 'ibaadat ki jaan' kyun kaha gaya hai.

title: Where du'as are accepted
summary: Hazrat's lesson from the story of Hazrat Zakariya and Bibi Maryam: the court of the awliya of Allah is a place where du'as are accepted. And why du'a is the core of worship.
ru_summary: Hazrat Zakariya aur Bibi Maryam ke qisse se Hazrat ka sabaq: Allah ke auliya ki baargaah woh jagah hai jahaan duaayein qabool hoti hain. Aur dua ibaadat ka maghz kyun hai.

title: Tasawwur-e-shaykh: its purpose
summary: What tasawwur-e-shaykh is, why it is done (so that the thought becomes fixed on one point), and how Hazrat describes its fruits and its cautions. An outline, not instructions.
ru_summary: Tasawwur-e-shaykh kya hai, kyun kiya jaata hai (taaki khayal ek nukte par jam jaaye), aur Hazrat iske samraat aur ehtiyaaton ko kaise bayaan karte hain. Sirf khaaka, tareeqa nahin.

title: Driving away stray thoughts (daf'-e-khatrat)
summary: What a khatra is, why a passing thought is forgiven but a resolve is not, and the outline of the methods the book gives for driving stray thoughts away.
ru_summary: Khatra kya hai, guzarta hua khayal kyun maaf hai lekin pakka iraada nahin, aur bhatakte khayalaat door karne ke jo tareeqe kitaab mein diye gaye hain unka khaaka.

title: Zikr in the dars
summary: The remembrance practices Hazrat speaks of: beginning with the verse that commands it, the pact of yaad-faramosh, and the adhkar of the Divine Names. Purpose and outline only.
ru_summary: Zikr ke woh amal jinka Hazrat zikr karte hain: hukm wali aayat se shuruaat, yaad-faramosh ka mu'ahida, aur Asma-e-Ilahi ke azkaar. Sirf maqsad aur khaaka.

title: Terms used in the dars
summary: A short glossary of the words Hazrat Azam Pasha R.A. uses, each explained only as he explains it, with where to hear it.
ru_summary: Hazrat Azam Pasha R.A. jo alfaaz istemaal karte hain unki mukhtasar farhang: har lafz sirf utna jitna woh khud samjhaate hain, aur kahaan sunein.

title: Questions and answers
summary: Five common questions, answered only from Hazrat Azam Pasha R.A.'s dars. Where the dars gives no answer, the question is for your teacher.
ru_summary: Paanch aam sawaal, jinke jawaab sirf Hazrat Azam Pasha R.A. ke dars se diye gaye hain. Jahaan dars mein jawaab nahin, woh sawaal apne ustaad se poochiye.
